scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/tests tests playwright.config.ts tokens.css
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src backend/src backend/tests tests playwright.config.ts tokens.css
